description: By-eye review of bake/parking-rows.mjs on the NGII sheet (and the VR tour where noted): addAreas are search areas the traces miss, rejectRows are rows the detector found that are not stall rows, each with its reason. Coordinates WGS84.

kerb strip between the road and the grass verge (yellow kerb line), no stalls
lines of a hatched island at the lot corner read as dividers
diagonal hatch of the island next to the lot read as dividers
edge of the shaded lot over the tree verge: canopy shadow stripes, no stalls
paving joints and yellow guide lines of a pedestrian plaza, no stalls
kerb and verge pieces at a road bend, no stalls
row reaching onto the building roof edge: roof seams read as dividers
